title: Mailbox id check refuses the nil UUID with 400 where it previously reached lookup and returned 404
outcome: The read/acknowledge mailbox id contract treats "mailbox-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" deliberately: either it is accepted as a canonical lowercase UUID and reaches lookup (404 when unknown), or the non-nil requirement is stated in the 400 message and documented and tested.
acceptance: Mailbox id check refuses the nil UUID with 400 where it previously reached lookup and returned 404 is done
